journey: Read a script in the teleprompter
app: Factory Video Studio, Kotlin Toolchain Android target
note: The app was rebuilt after fixing the zero-scroll-range state handling. The long test script provided a scrollable region. One literal percent in the fixture came from a mistyped adb text escape; it did not affect control assertions.

results.action: Verify Factory home and Start a script are visible
results.comment: Factory home and primary script action were visible.

results.action: Tap Script title and check it has focus
results.comment: The title text field exposed focused state.

results.action: Enter Teleprompter test in the Script title field
results.comment: The title appeared as Teleprompter test.

results.action: Tap Your words and check the field has focus
results.comment: The body field exposed focused state.

results.action: Enter and verify a long script body
commands: adb -s emulator-5554 shell input text '<long sample script with Android %s space escapes>'
results.comment: A nonempty script was visible in the editor and produced a scrollable reader region.

results.action: Tap Read in teleprompter and verify controls
results.comment: Reader, text size, scroll speed, Start scrolling, and Back to beginning controls were visible.

results.action: Tap A+ and verify text size changes from 36sp to 40sp
Start scrolling and verify the control changes to Pause scrolling
results.comment: With long content, the script scrolled and the button label became Pause scrolling.
The control returned to Start scrolling.
The reader returned to the first script lines.

results.action: Tap Script and verify the editor returns
results.comment: Write your script and the draft fields were visible again.
